requirements_to_testpoints.requirement_text: 按钮（D2）控制系统开关：开启后 A0 控制 D9 LED，否则关闭
requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: Step io_0 from false to true while sweeping io_2 across multiple values; then set io_0 back to false while keeping io_2 at a nonzero value.
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: When io_0 is true, io_1 equals the current io_2 value; when io_0 is false, io_1 is 0.0 regardless of io_2.
